lens: human-first handling of candidate evidence, respectful uncertainty, recruiter restraint, reversibility, and avoidance of manufactured urgency

findings.criterion: Live candidate transparency and consent language
findings.observation: The evaluated record is synthetic and localhost-only. It retains only reviewed selected text with a named source-retention policy and deadline, keeps candidate words separate from recruiter correction, and performs no candidate contact. It does not evaluate live candidate notice, consent, correction, or retention language.
findings.user_impact: The localhost slice is restrained, but a live candidate would still need a clear route to understand and challenge use of their conversation.
findings.recommendation: Before live data, evaluate candidate-facing notice, purpose limitation, correction, retention, and deletion.
findings.verification: A candidate can learn what was retained, why, until when, who can correct it, and how deletion propagates.

findings.observation: Dismissal no longer leaks into action authority, corrections preserve the original exact quote, and unknown/offline states avoid manufactured success. Operator interpretation remains untested.
findings.user_impact: The interface avoids pressuring the candidate through false certainty, while real recruiter paraphrase is still inferred.
findings.recommendation: Ask first-time recruiters to paraphrase proposed, confirmed, dismissed, approved, unknown, and verified.
findings.verification: Participants do not report a proposal as a candidate fact or approval as a completed candidate-facing action.

strengths: The retained evidence scope is the reviewed selected text, not the surrounding page or browser history.
The original quote remains visible after a long recruiter correction.
Dismissal grants no authority and does not rank or devalue the candidate.
All effects are synthetic, recruiter-owned, deterministic, and localhost-only.
missing_evidence: Candidate-facing notice, correction, retention, and consent evaluation for live data.
open_questions: How will a live candidate request correction or deletion of evidence-derived working state?
